title: Southeast Asia’s digital economy to hit $368 billion
text: Widespread AI adoption is propelling Southeast Asia's digital economy to a projected $368 billion in 2026 and $1 trillion by 2035.

title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
text: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
text: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
text: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
text: SpaceX hit profitability in the third quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
text: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
text: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
text: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat

title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
text: Eric Schmidt’s fortune is about to get even bigger.

title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
text: New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in its LEGO era’
text: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.

title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
text: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.

title: Figma co-founder Dylan Field thinks MCP is not a perfect protocol
text: Figma said it plans to support as many standards as possible without exposing all of its data.

title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
text: The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
text: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking up a wide range of objects, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.

title: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant
text: Yelp is embedding numerous new AI features into its app that can do everything from call to check on restaurant wait times to create personalized recommendations that remember your preferences.

title: Otter AI raises $320M from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
text: Otter.ai said that it will use these funds for enterprise growth, go-to-market strategy, international expansion, and product innovation.

title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
text: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.
